messages:
deploybot: ALERT: prod-canary cluster failed healthcheck 5/5 nodes at 2026-03-23T14:15:00Z. Auto-rollback suppressed due to release pin. Hotfix image ready: redwood/inference:2026-03-23-hotfix-3. Requesting expedited approval to lift pin and roll forward in a 20m change window. @jen @marco @ops-oncall please ack.

jen: on it. can you paste the failing test/log? :eyes:

deploybot: failing probe: /health/query-latency > 500ms. sample: 
```
ERROR: kv-cache miss spike -> increased p95 latency
module: runtime.kv-cache
heap: transient growth 40% -> gc thrash
stack: /srv/runtime/main:kv_fetch
```

marco: looks like kv-cache eviction thrash. we've seen this with the quant patch before. is this the hotfix that reverts the q-kv tweak?

anita: yes, hotfix is a small revert + bump to kv eviction threshold. validated on staging with our smoke set. 6 runs green.

yuki: @ops-oncall can we get infra signal (node CPU/mem) and confirmation no other rolling jobs are queued?

ops-oncall: checking now. nodes show a transient CPU spike coincident with deploy, no other batch jobs. disk IO normal. no scheduled maintenance.

jen: thanks. i'm +1 to expedited lift if PM owns release notes and we pin the exact image. @lee please confirm release notes and opt-in list?

lee: i'll patch release notes and notify customers on the outstanding dedicated contracts. image pinned to redwood/inference:2026-03-23-hotfix-3. will append regression note.

marco: roll plan: lift pin -> deploy hotfix to canary (10%) -> 10m telemetry -> if good -> ramp to 100% over 10m. rollback if p95 > baseline + 25% or error rate > 0.5%.

jen: create canary guard rails in the deploybot command?

deploybot: run command queued: `/deploy release --image redwood/inference:2026-03-23-hotfix-3 --scope canary --ramp 10% --observe 600s --auto-rollback-threshold "p95>+25% || errors>0.5%" --override-pin release-lead-ack`

anita: QA signoff: smoke set pass, integration quick-check passed, no new model diffs.

yuki: infra ack — no queued jobs, cluster healthy baseline.

ops-oncall: leaving a bookmark: if we hit the rollback threshold, handoff to oncall immediately and freeze any new deploys.

jen: i'm approving. i'm the release lead. +approve (expedite).

marco: +deploy from me (eng lead).

lee: +pm-notified and release notes updated.

deploybot: APPROVAL: release-lead jen and eng-lead marco approved. Executing: lift pin and start canary roll. Will post updates every 2m.

deploybot: 14:18 UTC - canary 10% started. telemetry window 10m.

anita: watching logs and client error stream. so far p95 stable.

deploybot: 14:25 UTC - telemetry update: p50/p95/p99 = 45ms/120ms/340ms (baseline 40/95/300). error rate 0.08%. within thresholds.

jen: good. proceed with ramp to 100% over next 10m when ready.

marco: initiating ramp. deploybot, continue guard rails.

deploybot: 14:36 UTC - ramp complete: 100% traffic on redwood/inference:2026-03-23-hotfix-3. No auto-rollback triggered.

yuki: marking incident as resolved for the canary failure. will create follow-up postmortem to document root cause and long-term fix for kv-cache tuning.

jen: thanks team. release notes link: https://go/release/2026-03-23-hotfix-3 (lee added details). leaving pin removed and rollout recorded. :tada:

lee: I'll send customer notice and update the dedicated capacity changelog.

ops-oncall: all good here — closing pager for this event.

deploybot: THREAD CLOSED: roll forward successful, pin removed. Logs archived under run-id 20260323-ff12.
